claim_limit: A passing live receipt proves an authenticated two-turn text-to-audio protocol smoke only. It does not prove listening/acoustic quality, playback, microphone input, interruption, or soak behavior.
scope: Read-only/offline independent review of realtime_restoration_probe_v3.py. No endpoint connection, inference, lifecycle action, credential read, or product edit.

conditions: Use the fixture, interpreter invocation, product client, and production config identities bound by the sidecar.
Use a new absent private output path and load the named local token environment variable externally.
Independently verify the final receipt, its source/code/config/client identities, passed flag, two correlated turns, and scope before making restoration claims.

verified.bounds: Absolute 10-second handshake, 60-second turn, and 150-second total deadlines plus event, wire, message-fragment, transcript, response-id, send, and audio caps are enforced with explicit require calls and remain active under Python -O.
verified.client_identity: The exact pinned product ws.py bytes are SHA-checked and compiled from the same byte snapshot before use.
verified.configuration: One bounded config snapshot must match exact production SHA cc165f8bb7f7eb5b3a704acda7af228f8649de9398cd701197b0936218eb4a23 before client load/network. Its numeric IP and integer port are validated.
verified.correlation: Exactly one response.created per turn; every accepted audio/transcript event requires the matching bounded response_id; nested response.done id must match; ids cannot be reused across turns.
verified.fixture_identity: A bounded source snapshot is compiled with the captured filename and must equal the module code object captured at entry. The receipt records source SHA and a deterministic explicit-code-attribute digest; comments/whitespace remain covered by the separate source SHA rather than an execution claim.
offline_regressions: replacement/hardlink before calls and after fsync
verified.output_custody: O_EXCL 0600 reservation occurs before config/client/network; fstat/lstat regular-file, device/inode, nlink=1 and mode checks occur before each connection, before write, and after fsync. Replacement/hardlink races return receipt_published=false and never overwrite the substituted path.
verified.runtime_sidecar: The sidecar binds fixture/tests, CPython 3.14.6 resolved executable SHA, optimization=0, product WebSocket client SHA, production config SHA, and preserved v1/v2 identities.
verified.sanitization: Token values, raw exception/header text, raw response ids, unexpected transcript, and PCM bytes are never published; failures use static codes.
verified.success_contract: Unauthenticated WebSocket upgrade is rejected with exact HTTP 401; two fixed text turns each require exact terminal transcript, consistent deltas if present, nonempty even-byte PCM, and completed response.done.
